rationales: Emil Fischer is known for work on sugars and proteins, not for first proposing metabolism.
Ibn-e-Nafis is credited in this context with first giving the concept of metabolism.
Jabir Bin Hayyan is associated chiefly with the development of chemistry.
Wilhelm Kühne coined the term enzyme, rather than first giving the concept of metabolism.
Pasteur did not discover meiosis.
Golgi is known for discovering the Golgi apparatus, not meiosis.
Walther Fleming studied cell division, but Oscar Hertwig is credited with discovering meiosis.
Oscar Hertwig is credited with discovering meiosis in 1876.
Regeneration is the replacement or regrowth of damaged parts, not the formation of secondary tumors.
Crossing over is the exchange of genetic material between homologous chromosomes.
Metastasis is the spread of cancer cells that can form new tumors at other sites.
Synapsis is the pairing of homologous chromosomes during meiosis.
The nucleolus produces and assembles ribosomal subunits.
Plastids do not construct cellular ribosomes.
The endoplasmic reticulum may have ribosomes attached but does not construct them.
The cell wall does not construct ribosomes.
Family is a taxonomic rank above genus and species.
Species is the basic unit of biological classification.
Class is a taxonomic rank above order and family.
Genus is a taxonomic rank above species.
Deduction is used to derive testable predictions after forming a hypothesis.
A hypothesis is proposed after observations identify a problem.
Experiments test a hypothesis and are not the first step.
Observations are the first step in solving a biological problem.
A tissue is a group of similar cells performing the same function.
An organelle is a specialized structure within a cell.
An organ consists of different tissues working together.
An organ system is a group of organs working together.
Meiosis was not discovered in 1976.
Oscar Hertwig is credited with discovering meiosis in 1876.
Meiosis was not discovered in 1786.
Meiosis was not discovered in 1796.
Chromosomes are duplicated during the S phase of interphase.
The G₁ phase is mainly for cell growth before DNA replication.
The G₁ phase is mainly for cell growth before DNA replication.
The G₀ phase is a resting or non-dividing state, not the chromosome-duplication phase.
Cisternae are flattened membrane sacs, especially in the endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi apparatus.
Stroma is the fluid-filled interior of a chloroplast.
Grana are stacks of thylakoids in chloroplasts.
Cristae are the infoldings of the inner mitochondrial membrane.
Protista does not include the prokaryotes in the five-kingdom classification.
Monera includes prokaryotic organisms in the five-kingdom classification.
Fungi are eukaryotic organisms.
Plants are eukaryotic organisms.
Zoology is the study of animals.
Microbiology is the study of microorganisms.
Botany is the study of plants.
Morphology studies the form and structure of organisms.
Monocytes are white blood cells and are not the blood components primarily responsible for clotting.
Neutrophils are white blood cells and do not form blood clots.
Lymphocytes are white blood cells involved in immunity, not blood clotting.
Basophils release heparin, which inhibits clotting; platelets are responsible for forming blood clots.
Most arteries do not have valves along their length to prevent backflow.
Veins contain valves that help prevent blood from flowing backward.
Capillaries have no valves.
Not all of these vessels have valves to prevent backflow.
One gram of protein provides about 4 kilocalories of energy.
One gram of fat provides about 9 kilocalories, not protein.
70 kilocalories per gram is not the energy value of protein.
100 kilocalories per gram is not the energy value of protein.
